parts.text: I work for the platform company, keeping the shared picture of the airspace for our customer companies. My work involves managing the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones that group them, and the closures announced by the authorities. These closures can be planned ones with a start and end time, or sudden ones that apply at once, and they are often amended during the day. When a closure is entered, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers.
